name: How long does a curbless shower conversion project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a curbless shower conversion project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical duration for a curbless shower conversion project can range from one to three weeks, though this can vary based on the scope of work and existing bathroom conditions. Factors influencing the timeline include demolition, subfloor modification for proper sloping, extensive waterproofing, tile installation and curing times, and fixture installation. Complex plumbing rerouting or unexpected structural issues can extend the project. Our team provides a detailed project schedule after an initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: A curbless shower conversion typically takes 1 to 3 weeks. The duration depends on demolition, subfloor modification, waterproofing, and tile curing.
